Dhambi huvunja uhusiano na Mungu
Dhambi huleta utengano na mauti

en: The proclamation of a definite time for Christ’s coming called forth great opposition from many of all classes, from the minister in the pulpit down to the most reckless, heaven-daring sinner. “No man knoweth the day nor the hour!” was heard alike from the hypocritical minister and the bold scoffer. They closed their ears to the clear and harmonious explanation of the text by those who were pointing to the close of the prophetic periods and to the signs which Christ Himself had foretold as tokens of His advent.

Many who professed to love the Saviour declared that they had no opposition to the preaching of His coming; they merely objected to the definite time. God’s all-seeing eye read their hearts. They did not wish to hear of Christ’s coming to judge the world in righteousness. They had been unfaithful servants, their works would not bear the inspection of the heart-searching God, and they feared to meet their Lord. Like the Jews at the time of Christ’s first advent, they were not prepared to welcome Jesus. Satan and his angels exulted and flung the taunt in the face of Christ and holy angels, that His professed people had so little love for Him that they did not desire His appearing.

Unfaithful watchmen hindered the progress of the work of God. As the people were roused, and began to inquire the way of salvation, these leaders stepped in between them and the truth, seeking to quiet their fears by falsely interpreting the Word of God. In this work Satan and unconsecrated ministers united, crying, Peace, peace, when God had not spoken peace. Like the Pharisees in Christ’s day, many refused to enter the kingdom of heaven themselves, and those who were entering in they hindered. The blood of these souls will be required at their hand.

Wherever the message of truth was proclaimed, the most humble and devoted in the churches were the first to receive it. Those who studied the Bible for themselves could but see the unscriptural character of the popular views of prophecy, and wherever the people were not deceived by the efforts of the clergy to misstate and pervert the faith, wherever they would search the Word of God for themselves, the advent doctrine needed only to be compared with the Scriptures to establish its divine authority.

Many were persecuted by their unbelieving brethren. In order to retain their position in the church, some consented to be silent in regard to their hope, but others felt that loyalty to God forbade them thus to hide the truths which He had committed to their trust. Not a few were cut off from the fellowship of the church for no other reason than expressing their belief in the coming of Christ. Very precious to those who bore the trial of their faith were the words of the prophet, “Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for My name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but He shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.” Isaiah 66:5.

Angels of God were watching with the deepest interest the result of the warning. When the churches as a body rejected the message, angels turned away from them in sadness. Yet there were in the churches many who had not yet been tested in regard to the advent truth. Many were deceived by husbands, wives, parents, or children, and were made to believe it a sin even to listen to such heresies as were taught by the Adventists. Angels were bidden to keep faithful watch over these souls; for another light was yet to shine upon them from the throne of God.
sw: Utangazaji wa muda maalumu wa kuja kwa Kristo ulizua upinzani mkubwa kutoka kwa watu wa matabaka yote, kuanzia kwa mchungaji mimbarini hadi kwa mwenye dhambi mkaidi na asiyemwogopa Mungu. “Hakuna mtu ajuaye siku wala saa!” ilisikika vivyo hivyo kutoka kwa mchungaji mnafiki na mdhihaki mjasiri. Waliziba masikio yao wasisikie maelezo ya wazi na yenye upatano ya fungu hilo kutoka kwa wale waliokuwa wakiashiria mwisho wa vipindi vya unabii na ishara ambazo Kristo Mwenyewe alikuwa amezitabiri kama alama za kuja Kwake.

Wengi waliokiri kumpenda Mwokozi walitangaza kwamba hawakuwa na upinzani dhidi ya kuhubiriwa kwa kuja Kwake; walipinga tu ule muda maalumu. Jicho la Mungu linaloona yote lilisoma mioyo yao. Hawakutaka kusikia juu ya kuja kwa Kristo kuhukumu ulimwengu kwa haki. Walikuwa watumishi wasio waaminifu, matendo yao yasingeweza kustahimili ukaguzi wa Mungu anayechunguza moyo, na waliogopa kukutana na Bwana wao. Kama Wayahudi wakati wa kuja kwa mara ya kwanza kwa Kristo, hawakuwa tayari kumkaribisha Yesu. Shetani na malaika zake walishangilia na kumrushia dhihaka Kristo na malaika watakatifu, kwamba watu Wake wanaokiri jina Lake walikuwa na upendo mdogo sana Kwake kiasi kwamba hawakutamani kutokea Kwake.

Walinzi wasio waaminifu walizuia maendeleo ya kazi ya Mungu. Wakati watu walipoamshwa na kuanza kuuliza njia ya wokovu, viongozi hawa waliingilia kati yao na ukweli, wakitafuta kutuliza hofu zao kwa kulitafsiri Neno la Mungu isivyo kweli. Katika kazi hii Shetani na wachungaji wasiowekwa wakfu waliungana, wakipiga kelele, Amani, amani, wakati Mungu alikuwa hajanena amani. Kama Mafarisayo katika siku za Kristo, wengi walikataa kuingia katika ufalme wa mbinguni wao wenyewe, na wale waliokuwa wakiingia waliwazuia. Damu ya roho hizi itadaiwa mikononi mwao.

Kila mahali ambapo ujumbe wa ukweli ulitangazwa, wanyenyekevu na waliojitolea zaidi makanisani walikuwa wa kwanza kuupokea. Wale waliojifunza Biblia wenyewe hawakuweza kuacha kuona tabia isiyo ya kimaandiko ya mitazamo maarufu ya unabii, na kila mahali ambapo watu hawakudanganywa na juhudi za makasisi kupotosha na kugeuza imani, kila mahali ambapo wangechunguza Neno la Mungu wao wenyewe, fundisho la marejeo lilihitaji tu kulinganishwa na Maandiko ili kuthibitisha mamlaka yake ya kimungu.

Wengi waliteswa na ndugu zao wasioamini. Ili kudumisha nafasi zao kanisani, wengine walikubali kukaa kimya kuhusu tumaini lao, lakini wengine walihisi kwamba uaminifu kwa Mungu uliwakataza kuficha ukweli ambao Yeye alikuwa ameuweka amana kwao. Si wachache waliotengwa na ushirika wa kanisa kwa sababu nyingine yoyote isipokuwa kuelezea imani yao katika kuja kwa Kristo. Yalikuwa ya thamani sana kwa wale waliobeba jaribu la imani yao maneno ya nabii, “Ndugu zenu wawachukiao, waliowatupa kwa ajili ya jina Langu, walisema, Bwana na atukuzwe; lakini Yeye atatokea kwa furaha yenu, nao watatahayari.” Isaya 66:5.

Malaika wa Mungu walikuwa wakitazama kwa maslahi makubwa matokeo ya onyo hilo. Wakati makanisa kama kikundi yalipokataa ujumbe huo, malaika waligeuka kutoka kwao kwa huzuni. Hata hivyo, kulikuwa na wengi makanisani ambao walikuwa bado hawajajaribiwa kuhusiana na ukweli wa marejeo. Wengi walidanganywa na waume, wake, wazazi, au watoto, na kufanywa waamini kuwa ni dhambi hata kusikiliza mafundisho hayo ya kigeni kama yale yaliyofundishwa na Waadventista. Malaika waliamriwa kuendelea kuwalinda kwa uaminifu watu hawa; kwani nuru nyingine ilikuwa bado iwaangazie kutoka kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Mungu.

en: With unspeakable desire those who had received the message watched for the coming of their Saviour. The time when they expected to meet Him was at hand. They approached this hour with a calm solemnity. They rested in sweet communion with God, an earnest of the peace that was to be theirs in the bright hereafter. None who experienced this hope and trust can forget those precious hours of waiting. Worldly business was for the most part laid aside for a few weeks. Believers carefully examined every thought and emotion of their hearts as if upon their deathbeds and in a few hours to close their eyes upon earthly scenes. There was no making of “ascension robes,” but all felt the need of internal evidence that they were prepared to meet the Saviour; their white robes were purity of soul, characters cleansed from sin by the atoning blood of Christ.

God designed to prove His people. His hand covered a mistake in the reckoning of the prophetic periods. Adventists did not discover the error, nor was it discovered by the most learned of their opponents. The latter said, “Your reckoning of the prophetic periods is correct. Some great event is about to take place, but it is not what Mr. Miller predicts; it is the conversion of the world, and not the second advent of Christ.”

The time of expectation passed, and Christ did not appear for the deliverance of His people. Those who with sincere faith and love had looked for their Saviour experienced a bitter disappointment. Yet the Lord had accomplished His purpose: He had tested the hearts of those who had professed to be waiting for His appearing. There were among them many who had been actuated by no higher motive than fear. Their profession of faith had not affected their hearts or their lives. When the expected event failed to take place, these persons declared that they were not disappointed; they had never believed that Christ would come. They were among the first to ridicule the sorrow of the true believers.

But Jesus and all the heavenly host looked with love and sympathy upon the tried and faithful yet disappointed ones. Could the veil separating the visible from the invisible world have been swept back, angels would have been seen drawing near to these steadfast souls and shielding them from the shafts of Satan.
sw: Kwa hamu isiyoelezeka, wale waliokuwa wameupokea ujumbe walikesha wakingojea kuja kwa Mwokozi wao. Wakati waliotegemea kukutana Naye ulikuwa karibu. Waliafikia saa hii kwa utulivu na unyenyekevu mkuu. Walipumzika katika ushirika mtamu na Mungu, kionjo cha amani ambayo ingekuwa yao katika maisha yajayo yenye utukufu. Hakuna yeyote aliyepitia tumaini hili na uaminifu huu anayeweza kusahau saa hizo za thamani za kungoja. Shughuli za kidunia kwa kiasi kikubwa ziliwekwa kando kwa wiki chache. Waumini walichunguza kwa makini kila fikira na hisia za mioyo yao kana kwamba wako kwenye vitanda vyao vya mauti na baada ya saa chache wangefunga macho yao kuacha mambo ya duniani. Hakukuwa na utengenezaji wa “makanzu ya kupaa,” lakini wote walihisi hitaji la ushahidi wa ndani kwamba walikuwa tayari kukutana na Mwokozi; kanzu zao nyeupe zilikuwa usafi wa roho, tabia zilizosafishwa dhidi ya dhambi kwa damu ya upatanisho ya Kristo.

Mungu alikusudia kuwajaribu watu Wake. Mkono Wake ulifunika kosa fulani katika ukokotoaji wa vipindi vya unabii. Waadventista hawakugundua kosa hilo, wala halikugunduliwa na wapinzani wao waliosoma sana. Hawa wa mwisho walisema, “Ukokotoaji wenu wa vipindi vya unabii ni sahihi. Tukio fulani kubwa liko karibu kutokea, lakini si lile ambalo Bw. Miller anatabiri; ni kuongoka kwa ulimwengu, na si kuja kwa mara ya pili kwa Kristo.”

Muda wa matarajio ulipita, na Kristo hakutokea kwa ajili ya ukombozi wa watu Wake. Wale ambao kwa imani ya dhati na upendo walikuwa wamemngojea Mwokozi wao walipata tamaa chungu. Hata hivyo Bwana alikuwa ametimiza kusudi Lake: Alikuwa ameijaribu mioyo ya wale waliokuwa wamekiri kuwa wanangojea kutokea Kwake. Walikuwepo miongoni mwao wengi ambao walikuwa wakiongozwa na nia isiyo na uzito zaidi ya hofu. Ukiri wao wa imani haukuwa umegusa mioyo yao wala maisha yao. Tukio lililotarajiwa liliposhindwa kutokea, watu hawa walitangaza kwamba hawakukata tamaa; hawakuwahi kuamini kwamba Kristo angekuja. Walikuwa miongoni mwa wa kwanza kudhihaki huzuni ya waumini wa kweli.

Lakini Yesu na jeshi lote la mbinguni walitazama kwa upendo na huruma wale waliojaribiwa na waaminifu, ingawa walikuwa wamekata tamaa. Kama pazia linalotenganisha ulimwengu unaoonekana na usioonekana lingeweza kuondolewa, malaika wangeonekana wakisogea karibu na roho hizi thabiti na kuwakinga dhidi ya mishale ya Shetani.

en: The churches that refused to receive the first angel’s message rejected light from heaven. That message was sent in mercy to arouse them to see their true condition of worldliness and backsliding, and to seek a preparation to meet their Lord. It was to separate the church of Christ from the corrupting influence of the world that the first angel’s message was given. But with the multitude, even of professed Christians, the ties which bound them to earth were stronger than the attractions heavenward. They chose to listen to the voice of worldly wisdom, and turned away from the heart-searching message of truth.

God gives light to be cherished and obeyed, not to be despised and rejected. The light which He sends becomes darkness to those who disregard it. When the Spirit of God ceases to impress the truth upon the hearts of men, all hearing is vain, and all preaching also is vain. When the churches spurned the counsel of God by rejecting the advent message, the Lord rejected them. The first angel was followed by a second, proclaiming, “Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Revelation 14:8.

This message was understood by Adventists to be an announcement of the moral fall of the churches in consequence of their rejection of the first message. The proclamation, “Babylon is fallen,” was given in the summer of 1844, and as the result, about fifty thousand withdrew from these churches.

Those who preached the first message had no purpose or expectation of causing divisions in the churches, or of forming separate organizations. “In all my labors,” said William Miller, “I never had the desire or thought to establish any separate interest from that of existing denominations, or to benefit one at the expense of another. I thought to benefit all. My whole object was a desire to convert souls to God, to notify the world of a coming judgment, and to induce my fellow men to make that preparation of heart which will enable them to meet their God in peace.”

For a time many of the churches welcomed his labors, but as they decided against the advent truth, they desired to suppress all agitation of the subject. Those who had accepted the doctrine were thus placed in a position of great trial and perplexity. They loved their churches, and were loth to separate from them; but as they were ridiculed and oppressed, many at last arose and cast off the yoke that had been imposed upon them.

Adventists, seeing that the churches rejected the testimony of God’s Word, could no longer regard them as constituting the church of Christ, “the pillar and ground of the truth;” and as the message, “Babylon is fallen,” began to be proclaimed, they felt themselves justified in separating from their former connection.

Since the rejection of the first message, a sad change has taken place in the churches. As truth is spurned, error is received and cherished. Love for God and faith in His Word have grown cold. The churches have grieved the Spirit of the Lord, and it has been in a great measure withdrawn.
sw: Makanisa yaliyokataa kupokea ujumbe wa malaika wa kwanza yalikataa nuru kutoka mbinguni. Ujumbe huo ulitumwa kwa rehema ili kuwaamsha waone hali yao halisi ya kupenda ulimwengu na kurudi nyuma, na kutafuta maandalizi ya kukutana na Bwana wao. Ilikuwa ni kwa ajili ya kuitenga kanisa la Kristo na ushawishi wa ufisadi wa ulimwengu ndipo ujumbe wa malaika wa kwanza ulitolewa. Lakini kwa umati wa watu, hata wa wale waliojiita Wakristo, vifungo vilivyowafunga duniani vilikuwa na nguvu kuliko mvuto wa kuelekea mbinguni. Walichagua kusikiliza sauti ya hekima ya kidunia, na wakageuka na kuuacha ujumbe wa ukweli unaochunguza moyo.

Mungu hutoa nuru ili ithaminiwe na kutiiwa, si ili idharauliwe na kukataliwa. Nuru Anayotuma inakuwa giza kwa wale wanaoipuuza. Wakati Roho wa Mungu anapoacha kukazia ukweli juu ya mioyo ya wanadamu, kusikia kote ni ubatili, na kuhubiri kote pia ni ubatili. Wakati makanisa yalipokataa shauri la Mungu kwa kuukataa ujumbe wa marejeo, Bwana aliwakataa. Malaika wa kwanza alifuatiwa na wa pili, akitangaza, “Umeanguka, umeanguka Babeli, mji ule ulio mkuu, kwa kuwa umewanywesha mataifa yote divai ya ghadhabu ya uasherati wake.” Ufunuo 14:8.

Ujumbe huu ulieleweka na Waadventista kuwa ni tangazo la anguko la kimaadili la makanisa kama matokeo ya kukataa kwao ujumbe wa kwanza. Tangazo la “Babeli umeanguka,” lilitolewa katika majira ya joto ya mwaka 1844, na kama matokeo, takriban watu elfu hamsini walijiondoa kwenye makanisa hayo.

Wale waliohubiri ujumbe wa kwanza hawakuwa na dhumuni wala mategemeo ya kusababisha migawanyiko katika makanisa, au kuanzisha mashirika tofauti. William Miller alisema, “Katika kazi zangu zote, sijawahi kuwa na hamu au wazo la kuanzisha maslahi yoyote tofauti na yale ya madhehebu yaliyopo, au kumnufaisha mmoja kwa gharama ya mwingine. Nilifikiri kuwanufaisha wote. Lengo langu lote lilikuwa hamu ya kuongoza roho kwa Mungu, kuuambia ulimwengu juu ya hukumu inayokuja, na kuwahimiza wanadamu wenzangu kufanya matengenezo hayo ya moyo yatakayowawezesha kukutana na Mungu wao kwa amani.”

Kwa muda fulani makanisa mengi yalikaribisha kazi zake, lakini walipoamua kupinga ukweli wa marejeo, walitaka kukandamiza msisimko wowote wa somo hilo. Wale waliokuwa wamekubali fundisho hilo walijikuta katika hali ya majaribu makubwa na mkanganyiko. Walipenda makanisa yao, na walikuwa na kusita kujitenga nayo; lakini walipodhihakiwa na kudhulumiwa, wengi hatimaye walisimama na kutupilia mbali nira waliyokuwa wamewekewa.

Waadventista, wakiona kuwa makanisa yalikataa ushuhuda wa Neno la Mungu, hawakuweza tena kuyaona kama yanayounda kanisa la Kristo, “nguzo na msingi wa kweli;” na ujumbe wa “Babeli umeanguka” ulipoanza kutangazwa, walijihisi kuwa na haki ya kujitenga na uhusiano wao wa zamani.

Tangu kukataliwa kwa ujumbe wa kwanza, mabadiliko ya kusikitisha yametokea katika makanisa. Wakati ukweli unapodhaliwa, kosa hupokelewa na kuthaminiwa. Upendo kwa Mungu na imani katika Neno Lake vimepoa. Makanisa yamemhuzunisha Roho wa Bwana, naye amejiondoa kwa kiasi kikubwa.

en: Sin is  of God’s law
sw: Dhambi huleta utengano na mauti

en: When the year 1843 entirely passed away unmarked by the advent of Jesus, those who had looked in faith for His appearing were for a time left in doubt and perplexity. But notwithstanding their disappointment, many continued to search the Scriptures, examining anew the evidences of their faith, and carefully studying the prophecies to obtain further light. The Bible testimony in support of their position seemed clear and conclusive. Signs which could not be mistaken pointed to the coming of Christ as near. The believers could not explain their disappointment; yet they felt assured that God had led them in their past experience.

Their faith was greatly strengthened by the direct and forcible application of those scriptures which set forth a tarrying time. As early as 1842, the Spirit of God had moved upon Charles Fitch to devise the prophetic chart, which was generally regarded by Adventists as a fulfillment of the command given by the prophet Habakkuk, to “write the vision, and make it plain upon tables.” No one, however, then saw the tarrying time which was brought to view in the same prophecy. After the disappointment the full meaning of this scripture became apparent. Thus speaks the prophet: “Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it, because it will surely come, it will not tarry.” Habakkuk 2:2, 3.

The waiting ones rejoiced that He who knows the end from the beginning had looked down through the ages, and, foreseeing their disappointment, had given them words of courage and hope. Had it not been for such portions of Scripture, showing that they were in the right path, their faith would have failed in that trying hour.

In the parable of the ten virgins, Matthew 25, the experience of Adventists is illustrated by the incidents of an Eastern marriage. “Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.” “While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.”

The widespread movement under the proclamation of the first message, answered to the going forth of the virgins, while the passing of the time of expectation, the disappointment, and the delay, were represented by the tarrying of the bridegroom. After the definite time had passed, the true believers were still united in the belief that the end of all things was at hand; but it soon became evident that they were losing, to some extent, their zeal and devotion, and were falling into the state denoted in the parable by the slumbering of the virgins during the tarrying time.

About this time fanaticism began to appear. Some who professed to be zealous believers in the message rejected the Word of God as the one infallible guide, and, claiming to be led by the Spirit, gave themselves up to the control of their own feelings, impressions, and imaginations. There were some who manifested a blind and bigoted zeal, denouncing all who would not sanction their course. Their fanatical ideas and exercises met with no sympathy from the great body of Adventists; yet they served to bring reproach upon the cause of truth.

The preaching of the first message in 1843, and of the midnight cry in 1844, tended directly to repress fanaticism and dissension. Those who participated in these solemn movements were in harmony; their hearts were filled with love for one another, and for Jesus, whom they expected soon to see. The one faith, the one blessed hope, lifted them above the control of any human influence and proved a shield against the assaults of Satan.
sw: Wakati mwaka 1843 ulipopita kabisa bila kuonekana kwa kuja kwa Yesu, wale waliokuwa wamengojea kwa imani kutokea Kwake waliachwa kwa muda katika shaka na mkanganyiko. Lakini licha ya kukata tamaa kwao, wengi waliendelea kuchunguza Maandiko, wakichunguza upya ushahidi wa imani yao, na kusoma kwa makini unabii ili kupata nuru zaidi. Ushahidi wa Biblia katika kuunga mkono msimamo wao ulionekana kuwa wazi na wa kuhitimisha. Ishara ambazo hazikuweza kukosewa ziliashiria kuja kwa Kristo kuwa karibu. Waumini hawakuweza kuelezea kukata tamaa kwao; lakini walihisi uhakika kwamba Mungu alikuwa amewaongoza katika uzoefu wao wa huko nyuma.

Imani yao iliimarishwa sana na utumiaji wa moja kwa moja na wenye nguvu wa maandiko hayo ambayo yalionyesha wakati wa kukawia. Mapema mwaka 1842, Roho wa Mungu alikuwa amemwongoza Charles Fitch kubuni chati ya unabii, ambayo kwa ujumla ilichukuliwa na Waadventista kama utimilifu wa amri iliyotolewa na nabii Habakuki, “iandike njozi, ukaifanye iwe wazi katika vibao.” Hakuna mtu, hata hivyo, aliyeona wakati wa kukawia ambao ulionyeshwa katika unabii huo huo wakati huo. Baada ya kukata tamaa, maana kamili ya andiko hili ikawa dhahiri. Nabii asema hivi: “Iandike njozi, ukaifanye iwe wazi katika vibao, ili aisomaye apate kupiga mbio. Kwa maana njozi hii bado ni kwa wakati ulioamriwa, lakini mwishoni itanena, wala haitasema uongo: ijapokawia, ingojee, kwa sababu itakuja bila shaka, haitakawia.” Habakuki 2:2, 3.

Wale waliokuwa wakingoja walifurahi kwamba Yeye ajuaye mwisho tangu mwanzo alikuwa ametazama chini kupitia karne zote, na, akiona mbele kukata tamaa kwao, alikuwa amewapa maneno ya ujasiri na tumaini. Isingekuwa kwa sehemu kama hizo za Maandiko, zikionyesha kwamba walikuwa katika njia sahihi, imani yao ingekuwa imeshindwa katika saa hiyo ya jaribu.

Katika mfano wa wanawali kumi, Mathayo 25, uzoefu wa Waadventista unafananishwa na matukio ya ndoa ya Mashariki. “Ndipo ufalme wa mbinguni utakapofanana na wanawali kumi, waliotwaa taa zao, wakatoka kwenda kumlaki bwana arusi.” “Na bwana arusi alipokawia, wote wakasinzia wakalala usingizi.”

Vuguvugu lililoenea sana chini ya utangazaji wa ujumbe wa kwanza, lililingana na kule kutoka kwa wanawali, wakati kupita kwa muda wa matarajio, kukata tamaa, na kuchelewa, kuliwakilishwa na kukawia kwa bwana arusi. Baada ya muda maalumu kupita, waumini wa kweli walikuwa bado wameungana katika imani kwamba mwisho wa mambo yote ulikuwa karibu; lakini punde ilionekana wazi kwamba walikuwa wakipoteza, kwa kiasi fulani, bidii na ujitoleaji wao, na walikuwa wakianguka katika hali iliyoonyeshwa katika mfano kwa kusinzia kwa wanawali wakati wa kukawia.

Karibu na wakati huu ushabiki ulianza kuonekana. Baadhi ya wale waliojidai kuwa waumini wenye bidii katika ujumbe huo walilikataa Neno la Mungu kama mwongozo pekee usio na makosa, na, wakidai kuongozwa na Roho, walijitoa kwenye udhibiti wa hisia, miguso, na mawazo yao wenyewe. Kulikuwa na wengine walioonyesha bidii ya upofu na ya kishabiki, wakiwashutumu wote ambao hawangeidhinisha mwenendo wao. Mawazo yao ya kishabiki na mazoezi yao hayakupata huruma yoyote kutoka kwa kundi kubwa la Waadventista; lakini yalitumika kuleta shutuma juu ya kazi ya ukweli.

Uhubiri wa ujumbe wa kwanza mnamo 1843, na wa kilio cha usiku wa manane mnamo 1844, ulielekea moja kwa moja kukandamiza ushabiki na mfarakano. Wale walioshiriki katika mivumo hii mizito walikuwa na upatano; mioyo yao ilijawa na upendo mmoja kwa mwingine, na kwa Yesu, ambaye walitarajia kumwona hivi karibu. Imani moja, tumaini moja lililobarikiwa, liliwainua juu ya udhibiti wa ushawishi wowote wa kibinadamu na ikawa ngao dhidi ya mashambulizi ya Shetani.

en: Sin is  of God’s law
sw: Dhambi huleta utengano na mauti

en: “While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept. And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him. Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.” Matthew 25:5-7. In the summer of 1844 Adventists discovered the mistake in their former reckoning of the prophetic periods, and settled upon the correct position. The 2300 days of Daniel 8:14, which all believed to extend to the second coming of Christ, had been thought to end in the spring of 1844; but it was now seen that this period extended to the autumn of the same year, and the minds of Adventists were fixed upon this point as the time for the Lord’s appearing.

The proclamation of this time message was another step in the fulfillment of the parable of the marriage, whose application to the experience of Adventists had already been clearly seen. As in the parable the cry was raised at midnight announcing the approach of the bridegroom, so in the fulfillment, midway between the spring of 1844, when it was first supposed that the 2300 days would close, and the autumn of 1844, at which time it was afterward found that they were really to close, such a cry was raised, in the very words of Scripture: “Behold, the Bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet Him.”

Like a tidal wave the movement swept over the land. From city to city, from village to village, and into remote country places it went, until the waiting people of God were fully aroused. Before this proclamation fanaticism disappeared, like early frost before the rising sun. Believers once more found their position, and hope and courage animated their hearts.

The work was free from those extremes which are ever manifested when there is human excitement without the controlling influence of the Word and Spirit of God. It was similar in character to those seasons of humiliation and returning unto the Lord which among ancient Israel followed messages of reproof from His servants. It bore the characteristics which mark the work of God in every age. There was little ecstatic joy, but rather deep searching of heart, confession of sin, and forsaking of the world. A preparation to meet the Lord was the burden of agonizing spirits. There was persevering prayer and unreserved consecration to God.

The midnight cry was not so much carried by argument, though the Scripture proof was clear and conclusive. There went with it an impelling power that moved the soul. There was no doubt, no questioning. Upon the occasion of Christ’s triumphal entry into Jerusalem, the people who were assembled from all parts of the land to keep the feast, flocked to the Mount of Olives, and as they joined the throng that were escorting Jesus, they caught the inspiration of the hour and helped to swell the shout, “Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord.” Matthew 21:9. In like manner did unbelievers who flocked to the Adventist meetings—some from curiosity, some merely to ridicule—feel the convincing power attending the message, “Behold, the Bridegroom cometh!”

At that time there was faith that brought answers to prayer—faith that had respect to the recompense of reward. Like showers of rain upon the thirsty earth, the Spirit of grace descended upon the earnest seekers. Those who expected soon to stand face to face with their Redeemer felt a solemn joy that was unutterable. The softening, subduing power of the Holy Spirit melted the heart, as wave after wave of the glory of God swept over the faithful, believing ones.

Carefully and solemnly those who received the message came up to the time when they hoped to meet their Lord. Every morning they felt that it was their first duty to secure the evidence of their acceptance with God. Their hearts were closely united, and they prayed much with and for one another. They often met together in secluded places to commune with God, and the voice of intercession ascended to heaven from the fields and groves. The assurance of the Saviour’s approval was more necessary to them than their daily food, and if a cloud darkened their minds, they did not rest until it was swept away. As they felt the witness of pardoning grace, they longed to behold Him whom their souls loved.
sw: “Hata bwana arusi alipokawia, wote wakasinzia wakalala usingizi. Lakini usiku wa manane, pakawa na ukelele, Haya, bwana arusi; tokeni mwende kumlaki. Ndipo walipoondoka wanawali wale wote, wakazitengeneza taa zao.” Mathayo 25:5-7. Katika majira ya joto ya mwaka 1844, Waadventista waligundua kosa katika ukokotoaji wao wa awali wa vipindi vya unabii, na kuanza msimamo sahihi. Siku 2300 za Danieli 8:14, ambazo wote waliamini kuwa zinafika hadi kuja kwa mara ya pili kwa Kristo, zilifikiriwa kuisha katika majira ya kuchipua ya mwaka 1844; lakini sasa ilionekana kuwa kipindi hiki kilifika hadi majira ya vuli ya mwaka huohuo, na akili za Waadventista zikaelekezwa kwenye jambo hili kama wakati wa kutokea kwa Bwana.

Utangazaji wa ujumbe huu wa wakati ulikuwa hatua nyingine katika utimilifu wa mfano wa ndoa, ambao matumizi yake katika uzoefu wa Waadventista yalikuwa yameshaonekana wazi. Kama ilivyokuwa katika mfano ukelele ulipigwa usiku wa manane ukitangaza kukaribia kwa bwana arusi, vivyo hivyo katika utimilifu, katikati ya majira ya kuchipua ya 1844 (wakati ilipodhaniwa awali kuwa siku 2300 zingeisha) na majira ya vuli ya 1844 (wakati ambao baadaye ilionekana kuwa ndipo zingeisha hasa), ukelele kama huo ulipigwa, kwa maneno yaleyale ya Maandiko: “Haya, bwana arusi; tokeni mwende kumlaki!”

Kama wimbi kubwa la maji, vuguvugu hilo lilivuma nchi nzima. Kutoka mji hadi mji, kijiji hadi kijiji, na hadi sehemu za mashambani za mbali lilienea, hadi watu wa Mungu waliokuwa wakingoja waliamshwa kikamilifu. Mbele ya tangazo hili ushabiki ulitoweka, kama umande wa asubuhi mbele ya jua linalochomoza. Waumini walipata tena msimamo wao, na tumaini na ujasiri vilihuisha mioyo yao.

Kazi hiyo ilikuwa huru kutokana na yale mambo ya kupita kiasi ambayo hujidhihirisha kila mara kunapokuwa na msisimko wa kibinadamu bila ushawishi unaodhibiti wa Neno na Roho wa Mungu. Ilifanana katika tabia na nyakati zile za unyenyekevu na kurudi kwa Bwana ambazo miongoni mwa Israeli wa kale zilifuata jumbe za karipio kutoka kwa watumishi Wake. Ilibeba sifa zinazozingatia kazi ya Mungu katika kila kizazi. Kulikuwa na furaha kidogo ya msisimko, bali kulikuwa na uchunguzi wa kina wa moyo, ungamo la dhambi, na kuuacha ulimwengu. Maandalizi ya kukutana na Bwana ndiyo yalikuwa mzigo wa roho zilizokuwa katika juhudi kuu. Kulikuwa na maombi ya kudumu na kujiweka wakfu kwa Mungu bila kubakiza kitu.

Kilio cha usiku wa manane hakikubebwa sana na hoja, ingawa ushahidi wa Maandiko ulikuwa wazi na wa kuhitimisha. Pamoja nacho kulikuwa na nguvu inayolazimisha iliyotikisa nafsi. Hakukuwa na shaka, wala maswali. Wakati wa kuingia kwa ushindi kwa Kristo Yerusalemu, watu waliokusanyika kutoka sehemu zote za nchi kuadhimisha sikukuu, walimiminika kwenye Mlima wa Mizeituni, na walipojiunga na umati uliokuwa ukimsindikiza Yesu, walipokea msukumo wa saa ile na kusaidia kuongeza sauti ya ukelele, “Amebarikiwa Yeye ajaye kwa jina la Bwana.” Mathayo 21:9. Vivyo hivyo, wasioamini waliofurika katika mikutano ya Waadventista—wengine kwa udadisi, wengine ili kudhihaki tu—walihisi nguvu ya kusadikisha iliyoambatana na ujumbe, “Haya, bwana arusi!”

Wakati huo kulikuwa na imani iliyoleta majibu ya maombi—imani iliyozingatia malipo ya thawabu. Kama manyunyu ya mvua juu ya nchi yenye kiu, Roho wa neema alishuka juu ya watafutaji wa dhati. Wale waliotarajia kusimama uso kwa uso na Mkombozi wao hivi karibu walihisi furaha nzito isiyoweza kutamkwa. Nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu ya kulainisha na kunyenyekeza iliyeyusha moyo, wakati wimbi baada ya wimbi la utukufu wa Mungu likipita juu ya wale waaminifu, wanaoamini.

Kwa uangalifu na unyenyekevu, wale walioupokea ujumbe walikaribia wakati ambao walitegemea kukutana na Bwana wao. Kila asubuhi walihisi kuwa wajibu wao wa kwanza ulikuwa kupata ushahidi wa kukubalika kwao na Mungu. Mioyo yao iliunganishwa kwa karibu, na waliomba sana pamoja na kwa ajili ya mmoja na mwingine. Mara nyingi walikutana pamoja katika sehemu za faragha ili kuzungumza na Mungu, na sauti ya maombezi ilipanda mbinguni kutoka mashambani na vichakani. Uhakika wa kibali cha Mwokozi ulikuwa wa lazima kwao kuliko chakula chao cha kila siku, na ikiwa wingu lilitia giza akili zao, hawakupumzika hadi lilipoondolewa. Walipohisi ushuhuda wa neema inayosamehe, walitamani sana kumwona Yeye ambaye nafsi zao zilimpenda.

en: But again they were destined to disappointment. The time of expectation passed, and their Saviour did not appear. With unwavering confidence they had looked forward to His coming, and now they felt as did Mary, when, coming to the Saviour’s tomb and finding it empty, she exclaimed with weeping, “They have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid Him.” John 20:13.

A feeling of awe, a fear that the message might be true, had for a time served as a restraint upon the unbelieving world. After the passing of the time this did not at once disappear; they dared not triumph over the disappointed ones, but as no tokens of God’s wrath were seen, they recovered from their fears and resumed their reproach and ridicule. A large class who had professed to believe in the Lord’s soon coming renounced their faith. Some who had been very confident were so deeply wounded in their pride that they felt like fleeing from the world. Like Jonah, they complained of God, and chose death rather than life.

Those who had based their faith upon the opinions of others, and not upon the Word of God, were now as ready to again exchange their views. The scoffers won the weak and cowardly to their ranks, and all united in declaring that there could be no more fears or expectations now. The time had passed, the Lord had not come, and the world might remain the same for thousands of years.

The earnest, sincere believers had given up all for Christ, and had shared His presence as never before. They had, as they believed, given their last warning to the world, and, expecting soon to be received into the society of their divine Master and the heavenly angels, they had, to a great extent, withdrawn from the unbelieving multitude. With intense desire they had prayed, “Come, Lord Jesus, and come quickly.” But He had not come. And now to take up again the heavy burden of life’s cares and perplexities, and to endure the taunts and sneers of a scoffing world, was indeed a terrible trial of faith and patience.

Yet this disappointment was not so great as was that experienced by the disciples at the time of Christ’s first advent. When Jesus rode triumphantly into Jerusalem, His followers believed that He was about to ascend the throne of David and deliver Israel from her oppressors. With high hopes and joyful anticipations they vied with one another in showing honor to their King. Many spread out their garments as a carpet in His path, or strewed before Him the leafy branches of the palm. In their enthusiastic joy they united in the glad acclaim, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”

When the Pharisees, disturbed and angered by this outburst of rejoicing, wished Jesus to rebuke His disciples, He replied, “If these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.” Luke 19:40. Prophecy must be fulfilled. The disciples were accomplishing the purpose of God; yet they were doomed to a bitter disappointment. But a few days had passed ere they witnessed the Saviour’s agonizing death and laid Him in the tomb. Their expectations had not been realized in a single particular, and their hopes died with Jesus. Not till their Lord had come forth triumphant from the grave could they perceive that all had been foretold by prophecy, and “that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead.” Acts 17:3.

In like manner was prophecy fulfilled in the first and second angels’ messages. They were given at the right time and accomplished the work which God designed to accomplish by them. The world had been looking on, expecting that if the time passed and Christ did not appear, the whole system of adventism would be given up. But while many, under strong temptation, yielded their faith, there were some who stood firm. They could detect no error in their reckoning of the prophetic periods. The ablest of their opponents had not succeeded in overthrowing their position. True, there had been a failure as to the expected event, but even this could not shake their faith in the Word of God.

God did not forsake His people; His Spirit still abode with those who did not rashly deny the light which they had received, and denounce the advent movement. The apostle Paul, looking down through the ages, had written words of encouragement and warning for the tried, waiting ones at this crisis: “Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward. For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise. For yet a little while, and He that shall come will come, and will not tarry. Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, My soul shall have no pleasure in him. But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.” Hebrews 10:35-39.

Their only safe course was to cherish the light which they had already received of God, hold fast to His promises, and continue to search the Scriptures, and patiently wait and watch to receive further light.
sw: Lakini tena walikuwa wamekusudiwa kukatishwa tamaa. Wakati wa matarajio ulipita, na Mwokozi wao hakutokea. Kwa ujasiri usioyumbayumba walikuwa wamengojekea kuja Kwake, na sasa walihisi kama Mariamu alivyohisi, alipofika kwenye kaburi la Mwokozi na kulikuta tupu, alilia akisema, “Wamemwondoa Bwana wangu, wala mimi sijui walikomweka.” Yohana 20:13.

Hisia ya hofu kuu, hofu kwamba ujumbe ule ungeweza kuwa wa kweli, kwa muda fulani ilikuwa imetumika kama kizuizi kwa ulimwengu usioamini. Baada ya kupita kwa wakati huo, hali hii haikutoweka mara moja; hawakuthubutu kuwakebehi wale waliokata tamaa, lakini kwa kuwa hakuna ishara za ghadhabu ya Mungu zilizonekana, walipona hofu zao na kuanza tena shutuma na dhihaka zao. Kundi kubwa la watu waliokiri kuamini kuja kwa Bwana hivi karibuni walikana imani yao. Baadhi ya wale waliokuwa na uhakika mkubwa walijeruhiwa vibaya katika kiburi chao kiasi kwamba walihisi kama kukimbia ulimwengu. Kama Yona, walimnung’unikia Mungu, na kuchagua kifo badala ya uzima.

Wale waliokuwa wameweka msingi wa imani yao juu ya maoni ya wengine, na si juu ya Neno la Mungu, sasa walikuwa tayari kubadilisha tena mitazamo yao. Wadhihaki walivuta watu dhaifu na waoga kwenye safu zao, na wote waliungana kutangaza kwamba hakuwezi kuwa na hofu au matarajio tena sasa. Wakati ulikuwa umepita, Bwana hakuja, na ulimwengu ungeweza kubaki vilevile kwa maelfu ya miaka.

Waumini wa dhati na wa kweli walikuwa wameacha vyote kwa ajili ya Kristo, na walikuwa wameshiriki uwepo Wake kuliko wakati mwingine wowote. Walikuwa, kama walivyoamini, wametoa onyo lao la mwisho kwa ulimwengu, na wakitarajia kupokelewa hivi karibuni katika ushirika wa Bwana wao wa kimungu na malaika wa mbinguni, walikuwa, kwa kiasi kikubwa, wamejitenga na umati usioamini. Kwa hamu kubwa walikuwa wameomba, “Njoo, Bwana Yesu, na uje upesi.” Lakini hakuja. Na sasa kuanza tena kubeba mzigo mzito wa mahangaiko na mikanganyiko ya maisha, na kuvumilia dhihaka na kashfa za ulimwengu unaodhihaki, kwa kweli lilikuwa jaribu la kutisha la imani na uvumilivu.

Hata hivyo kukata tamaa huku hakukuwa kukubwa kama kule walikopitia wanafunzi wakati wa kuja kwa mara ya kwanza kwa Kristo. Wakati Yesu alipoingia Yerusalemu kwa ushindi, wafuasi Wake waliamini kwamba alikuwa karibu kuketi kwenye kiti cha enzi cha Daudi na kuikomboa Israeli kutoka kwa watesi wake. Kwa matumaini makubwa na matarajio ya furaha walishindana wao kwa wao katika kumheshimu Mfalme wao. Wengi walitandaza nguo zao kama zulia njiani Mwake, au kutandaza mbele Yake matawi ya mitende. Katika furaha yao ya shauku waliungana katika kelele za furaha, “Hosana kwa Mwana wa Daudi!”

Wakati Mafarisayo, wakisumbuliwa na kukasirishwa na mlipuko huu wa furaha, walipotaka Yesu awakemee wanafunzi Wake, Alijibu, “Hawa wakinyamaza, mawe haya yatapiga kelele mara.” Luka 19:40. Unabii ulipaswa kutimia. Wanafunzi walikuwa wakitunza kusudi la Mungu; lakini walikuwa wamehukumiwa kukatishwa tamaa chungu. Lakini siku chache tu zilipita kabla ya kushuhudia kifo cha uchungu cha Mwokozi na kumweka kaburini. Matarajio yao hayakuwa yametimia hata katika jambo moja, na matumaini yao yalikufa pamoja na Yesu. Haikuwa mpaka Bwana wao alipotoka kwa ushindi kutoka kaburini ndipo walipoweza kutambua kwamba yote yalikuwa yametabiriwa na unabii, na “kwamba ilimpasa Kristo kuteswa, na kufufuka katika wafu.” Matendo 17:3.

Vivyo hivyo, unabii ulitimizwa katika jumbe za malaika wa kwanza na wa pili. Zilitolewa kwa wakati unaofaa na zilikamilisha kazi ambayo Mungu alikusudia kuikamilisha kupitia hizo. Ulimwengu ulikuwa ukitazama, ukitarajia kwamba ikiwa wakati ungepita na Kristo asitokee, mfumo mzima wa Uadventista ungeachwa. Lakini wakati wengi, chini ya majaribu makali, walisalimisha imani yao, kulikuwa na baadhi waliosimama imara. Hawakuweza kugundua kosa lolote katika ukokotoaji wao wa vipindi vya unabii. Wapinzani wao stadi zaidi walikuwa hawajafanikiwa kupindua msimamo wao. Ni kweli, kulikuwa na kushindwa kwa lile tukio lililotarajiwa, lakini hata hili lisingeweza kutikisa imani yao katika Neno la Mungu.

Mungu hakuwaacha watu Wake; Roho Wake bado alikaa na wale ambao hawakukana kwa haraka nuru waliyokuwa wameipokea, na kusingizia vuguvugu la marejeo. Mtume Paulo, akitazama mbele kupitia karne zote, alikuwa ameandika maneno ya kutia moyo na onyo kwa wale waliojaribiwa, wakingoja katika mgogoro huu: “Basi msiutupe ujasiri wenu, kwa maana una thawabu kuu. Kwa maana mnahitaji saburi, ili kwamba, mkiisha kuyafanya mapenzi ya Mungu, mpate ile ahadi. Kwa kuwa bado kitambo kidogo sana, Yeye ajaye atakuja, wala hatakawia. Lakini mwenye haki wangu ataishi kwa imani; naye akisita-sita, roho yangu haina furaha naye. Lakini sisi hatumo miongoni mwao wasita-sitao na kupotea, bali tumo miongoni mwa walio na imani ya kutuokoa roho zetu.” Waebrania 10:35-39.

Njia yao pekee ya salama ilikuwa kuthamini nuru ambayo walikuwa tayari wameipokea kutoka kwa Mungu, kushikilia ahadi Zake, na kuendelea kuchunguza Maandiko, na kungoja na kukesha kwa uvumilivu ili kupokea nuru zaidi.

Christ bore the penalty of sin

sw: Msalaba unaonyesha upendo na haki ya Mungu

en: The scripture which above all others had been both the foundation and central pillar of the advent faith was the declaration, “Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.” Daniel 8:14. These had been familiar words to all believers in the Lord’s soon coming. By the lips of thousands was this prophecy joyfully repeated as the watchword of their faith. All felt that upon the events therein brought to view depended their brightest expectations and most cherished hopes.

These prophetic days had been shown to terminate in the autumn of 1844. In common with the rest of the Christian world, Adventists then held that the earth, or some portion of it, was the sanctuary, and that the cleansing of the sanctuary was the purification of the earth by the fires of the last great day. This they understood would take place at the second coming of Christ. Hence the conclusion that Christ would return to the earth in 1844.

But the appointed time came, and the Lord did not appear. The believers knew that God’s Word could not fail; their interpretation of the prophecy must be at fault; but where was the mistake? Many rashly cut the knot of difficulty by denying that the 2300 days ended in 1844. No reason could be given for this position, except that Christ had not come at the time of expectation.

They argued that if the prophetic days had ended in 1844, Christ would then have come to cleanse the sanctuary by the purification of the earth by fire; and that since He had not come, the days could not have ended.

Though the majority of Adventists abandoned their former reckoning of the prophetic periods, and consequently denied the correctness of the movement based thereon, a few were unwilling to renounce points of faith and experience that were sustained by the Scriptures and by the special witness of the Spirit of God. They believed that they had adopted sound principles of interpretation in their study of the Scriptures, and that it was their duty to hold fast the truths already gained, and to still pursue the same course of Biblical research. With earnest prayer they reviewed their position, and studied the Scriptures to discover their mistake. As they could see no error in their explanation of the prophetic periods, they were led to examine more closely the subject of the sanctuary.
sw: Andiko ambalo kuliko mengine yote lilikuwa msingi na nguzo kuu ya imani ya marejeo lilikuwa ni lile tamko, “Hata jioni na asubuhi elfu mbili na mia tatu; ndipo patakatifu patapotakasika.” Danieli 8:14. Haya yalikuwa maneno yaliyozoeleka kwa waumini wote wa kuja kwa Bwana upesi. Kupitia vinywa vya maelfu, unabii huu ulikaririwa kwa furaha kama neno la siri la imani yao. Wote walihisi kuwa matukio yaliyoonyeshwa humo ndimo yalitegemea matarajio yao angavu zaidi na matumaini yao waliyoyathamini sana.

Siku hizi za unabii zilikuwa zimeonyeshwa kuishia katika majira ya vuli ya mwaka 1844. Pamoja na ulimwengu wote wa Kikristo, Waadventista wakati huo waliamini kuwa dunia, au sehemu fulani ya dunia, ndiyo lilikuwa patakatifu, na kwamba kutakaswa kwa patakatifu kulikuwa ni kutakaswa kwa dunia kwa moto wa siku kuu ya mwisho. Walielewa kuwa jambo hili lingetokea wakati wa kuja kwa mara ya pili kwa Kristo. Hivyo basi, wakafikia hitimisho kuwa Kristo angerudi duniani mnamo 1844.

Lakini wakati uliowekwa ulifika, na Bwana hakutokea. Waumini walijua kuwa Neno la Mungu haliwezi kushindwa; tafsiri yao ya unabii lazima ilikuwa na makosa; lakini kosa lilikuwa wapi? Wengi kwa haraka walikata fundo la ugumu huo kwa kukanusha kuwa siku 2300 ziliisha mnamo 1844. Hakuna sababu iliyoweza kutolewa kwa msimamo huo, isipokuwa tu kwamba Kristo hakuja wakati wa matarajio.
Walidai kuwa kama siku za unabii zingeisha mnamo 1844, Kristo angekuja wakati huo kutakasa patakatifu kwa kuitakasa dunia kwa moto; na kwa kuwa Hakuja, basi siku hizo zisingeweza kuwa zimeisha.

Ingawa idadi kubwa ya Waadventista waliacha ukokotoaji wao wa awali wa vipindi vya unabii, na hivyo kukanusha usahihi wa vuguvugu lililojengwa juu yake, wachache hawakuwa tayari kukana vipengele vya imani na uzoefu ambao ulitegemezwa na Maandiko na ushuhuda maalum wa Roho wa Mungu. Waliamini kuwa walikuwa wamefuata kanuni thabiti za tafsiri katika kujifunza kwao Maandiko, na kwamba ulikuwa wajibu wao kushikilia sana kweli ambazo tayari walikuwa wamezipata, na kuendelea na mkondo uleule wa utafiti wa Biblia. Kwa maombi ya dhati walipitia upya msimamo wao, na kujifunza Maandiko ili kugundua kosa lao. Kwa kuwa hawakuona kosa lolote katika maelezo yao ya vipindi vya unabii, waliongozwa kuchunguza kwa ukaribu zaidi somo la patakatifu.

en: In their investigation they learned that the earthly sanctuary, built by Moses at the command of God according to the pattern shown him in the mount, was “a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices”; that its two holy places were “patterns of things in the heavens”; that Christ, our great High Priest, is “a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man”; that “Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us.” Hebrews 9:9, 23; 8:2; Hebrews 9:24.

The sanctuary in heaven, in which Jesus ministers in our behalf, is the great original, of which the sanctuary built by Moses was a copy. As the sanctuary on earth had two apartments, the holy and the most holy, so there are two holy places in the sanctuary in heaven. And the ark containing the law of God, the altar of incense, and other instruments of service found in the sanctuary below, have also their counterpart in the sanctuary above. In holy vision the apostle John was permitted to enter heaven, and he there beheld the candlestick and the altar of incense, and as “the temple of God was opened,” he beheld also “the ark of His testament.” Revelation 4:5; 8:3; Revelation 11:19.

Those who were seeking for the truth found indisputable proof of the existence of a sanctuary in heaven. Moses made the earthly sanctuary after a pattern which was shown him. Paul declared that that pattern was the true sanctuary which is in heaven. (Hebrews 8:2, 5.) John testified that he saw it in heaven.

At the termination of the 2300 days, in 1844, no sanctuary had existed on earth for many centuries; therefore the sanctuary in heaven must be the one brought to view in the declaration, “Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.” But how could the sanctuary in heaven need cleansing? Turning again to the Scriptures, the students of prophecy learned that the cleansing was not a removal of physical impurities, for it was to be accomplished with blood, and therefore must be a cleansing from sin. Thus says the apostle: “It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these [the blood of animals]; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these [even the precious blood of Christ].” Hebrews 9:23.
sw: Katika uchunguzi wao walijifunza kuwa patakatifu pa duniani, palipojengwa na Musa kwa amri ya Mungu kulingana na mfano alioonyeshwa mlimani, palikuwa “mfano wa wakati huo wa sasa, ambapo sadaka na dhabihu zilitolewa”; kwamba mahali pake pawili patakatifu palikuwa “mifano ya mambo yaliyo mbinguni”; kwamba Kristo, Kuhani wetu Mkuu, ni “mhudumu wa patakatifu, na wa ile hema ya kweli, ambayo Bwana aliiweka, wala si mwanadamu”; kwamba “Kristo hakuingia katika patakatifu palipofanywa kwa mikono, ndio mfano wa ule wa kweli; bali aliingia mbinguni hasa, aonekane sasa mbele za Mungu kwa ajili yetu.” Waebrania 9:9, 23; 8:2; 9:24.

Patakatifu pa mbinguni, ambapo Yesu anahudumu kwa niaba yetu, ndicho kile chapa asili kuu, ambacho patakatifu palipojengwa na Musa palikuwa nakala yake. Kama vile patakatifu pa duniani palivyokuwa na vyumba viwili, patakatifu na patakatifu mno, vivyo hivyo kuna mahali pawili patakatifu katika patakatifu pa mbinguni. Na sanduku lenye sheria ya Mungu, madhabahu ya kufukizia uvumba, na vyombo vingine vya huduma vilivyopatikana katika patakatifu pa chini, pia vina mfano wake katika patakatifu pa juu. Katika maono matakatifu mtume Yohana aliruhusiwa kuingia mbinguni, na huko aliona kinara cha taa na madhabahu ya uvumba, na wakati “hekalu la Mungu lilipofunguliwa,” aliona pia “sanduku la agano lake.” Ufunuo 4:5; 8:3; 11:19.

Wale waliokuwa wakitafuta ukweli walipata ushahidi usiopingika wa kuwepo kwa patakatifu mbinguni. Musa alitengeneza patakatifu pa duniani kwa kufuata mfano alioonyeshwa. Paulo alitangaza kwamba mfano huo ulikuwa patakatifu pa kweli palipo mbinguni. (Waebrania 8:2, 5.) Yohana alishuhudia kwamba alipaona mbinguni.

Mwishoni mwa zile siku 2300, mnamo 1844, hapakuwa na patakatifu duniani kwa karne nyingi; kwa hivyo patakatifu pa mbinguni lazima ndipo palipoonyeshwa katika lile tamko, “Hata jioni na asubuhi elfu mbili na mia tatu; ndipo patakatifu patapotakasika.” Lakini patakatifu pa mbinguni pangewezaje kuhitaji kutakaswa? Wakirudi tena kwenye Maandiko, wanafunzi wa unabii walijifunza kwamba kutakaswa huko hakukuwa kuondolewa kwa uchafu wa kimwili, kwa maana kulipaswa kutimizwa kwa damu, na kwa hivyo lazima kuwe ni kutakaswa kwa dhambi. Hivyo ndivyo asemavyo mtume: “Basi ilikuwa lazima mifano ya mambo yaliyo mbinguni isafishwe kwa hayo [damu ya wanyama]; lakini mambo ya mbinguni yenyewe yasafishwe kwa dhabihu zilizo bora kuliko hizo [hata damu ya thamani ya Kristo].” Waebrania 9:23.

en: As the sins of the people were anciently transferred, in figure, to the earthly sanctuary by the blood of the sin offering, so our sins are, in fact, transferred to the heavenly sanctuary by the blood of Christ. And as the typical cleansing of the earthly was accomplished by the removal of the sins by which it had been polluted, so the actual cleansing of the heavenly is to be accomplished by the removal, or blotting out, of the sins which are there recorded.

This necessitates an examination of the books of record to determine who, through repentance of sin and faith in Christ, are entitled to the benefits of His atonement. The cleansing of the sanctuary therefore involves a work of investigative judgment. This work must be performed prior to the coming of Christ to redeem His people, for when He comes, His reward is with Him to give to every man according to his works. (Revelation 22:12.)

Thus those who followed in the advancing light of the prophetic word saw that instead of coming to the earth at the termination of the 2300 days in 1844, Christ then entered the most holy place of the heavenly sanctuary, into the presence of God, to perform the closing work of atonement, preparatory to His coming.
sw: Kama vile dhambi za watu zilivyohamishwa hapo kale, kwa mfano, hadi kwenye patakatifu pa duniani kwa damu ya dhabihu ya dhambi, vivyo hivyo dhambi zetu, kwa kweli, zinahamishiwa kwenye patakatifu pa mbinguni kwa damu ya Kristo. Na kama vile kutakaswa kwa mfano kwa patakatifu pa duniani kulivyotimizwa kwa kuondolewa kwa dhambi ambazo zilikuwa zimepachafua, vivyo hivyo kutakaswa halisi kwa patakatifu pa mbinguni kunapaswa kutimizwa kwa kuondolewa, au kufutwa kabisa, kwa dhambi ambazo zimerekodiwa huko.

Hili linahitaji uchunguzi wa vitabu vya kumbukumbu ili kubaini ni nani, kwa njia ya toba ya dhambi na imani katika Kristo, anastahili kupata faida za upatanisho Wake. Kwa hivyo, kutakaswa kwa patakatifu kunahusisha kazi ya hukumu ya upelelezi. Kazi hii lazima ifanyike kabla ya kuja kwa Kristo kuwakomboa watu Wake, kwa maana Atakapokuja, ijara Yake i pamoja Naye kumlipa kila mtu kama kazi yake ilivyo. (Ufunuo 22:12.)

Hivyo wale waliofuata nuru inayozidi kuangaza ya neno la unabii waliona kwamba badala ya kuja duniani mwishoni mwa siku 2300 mnamo 1844, Kristo wakati huo aliingia katika patakatifu mno pa patakatifu pa mbinguni, mbele za Mungu, ili kufanya kazi ya kufunga ya upatanisho, kama maandalizi ya kuja Kwake.

en: When Christ entered the most holy place of the heavenly sanctuary to perform the closing work of the atonement, He committed to His servants the last message of mercy to be given to the world. Such is the warning of the third angel of Revelation 14. Immediately following its proclamation, the Son of man is seen by the prophet coming in glory to reap the harvest of the earth.

As foretold in the Scriptures, the ministration of Christ in the most holy place began at the termination of the prophetic days in 1844. To this time apply the words of the Revelator, “The temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in His temple the ark of His testament.” Revelation 11:19. The ark of God’s testament is in the second apartment of the sanctuary. As Christ entered there, to minister in the sinner’s behalf, the inner temple was opened, and the ark of God was brought to view.

They had by faith followed their High Priest from the holy to the most holy, and they saw Him pleading His blood before the ark of God. Within that sacred ark is the Father’s law, the same that was spoken by God Himself amid the thunders of Sinai, and written with His own finger on the tables of stone. Not one command has been annulled; not a jot or tittle has been changed. While God gave to Moses a copy of His law, He preserved the great original in the sanctuary above.

Tracing down its holy precepts, the seekers for truth found, in the very bosom of the Decalogue, the fourth commandment, as it was first proclaimed: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy... the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord thy God.” Exodus 20:8-11. The Spirit of God impressed the hearts of these students of His Word. The conviction was urged upon them that they had ignorantly transgressed the fourth commandment by disregarding the Creator’s rest day.

They could find no evidence in the Scriptures that the fourth commandment had been abolished, or that the Sabbath had been changed; the blessing which first hallowed the seventh day had never been removed. They at once evinced their loyalty to God by keeping His Sabbath holy.

Those who had accepted the light concerning the mediation of Christ and the perpetuity of the law of God, found that these were the truths brought to view in the third message. The angel declares, “Here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Revelation 14:12. This statement is preceded by a solemn and fearful warning against the worship of the beast and his image.
sw: Wakati Kristo alipoingia katika patakatifu mno pa patakatifu pa mbinguni ili kufanya kazi ya kufunga ya upatanisho, Aliwakabidhi watumishi Wake ujumbe wa mwisho wa rehema utakaotolewa kwa ulimwengu. Huo ndio onyo la malaika wa tatu wa Ufunuo 14. Mara tu baada ya kutangazwa kwake, Mwana wa Adamu anaonekana na nabii akija katika utukufu kuvuna mavuno ya dunia.

Kama ilivyotabiriwa katika Maandiko, huduma ya Kristo katika patakatifu mno ilianza mwishoni mwa siku za unabii mnamo 1844. Wakati huu unahusiana na maneno ya Mfunuaji, “Hekalu la Mungu lilifunguliwa mbinguni, na sanduku la agano Lake likaonekana ndani ya hekalu Lake.” Ufunuo 11:19. Sanduku la agano la Mungu liko katika chumba cha pili cha patakatifu. Kristo alipoingia huko, ili kuhudumu kwa niaba ya mwenye dhambi, hekalu la ndani lilifunguliwa, na sanduku la Mungu likaonekana.

Walikuwa wamemfuata Kuhani wao Mkuu kwa imani kutoka patakatifu hadi patakatifu mno, na walimwona akitetea kwa damu Yake mbele ya sanduku la Mungu. Ndani ya sanduku hilo takatifu kuna sheria ya Baba, ileile iliyonunuliwa na Mungu Mwenyewe katikati ya radi za Sinai, na kuandikwa kwa kidole Chake Mwenyewe kwenye mbao za mawe. Hakuna amri hata moja iliyofutwa; wala nukta au herufi moja haijabadilishwa. Wakati Mungu alimpa Musa nakala ya sheria Yake, Alihifadhi chapa asili kuu katika patakatifu pa mbinguni.

Wakifuata maagizo yake matakatifu, watafutaji wa ukweli walipata, katikati kabisa ya Amri Kumi, amri ya nne, kama ilivyotangazwa mara ya kwanza: “Ikumbuke siku ya Sabato uitakase... siku ya saba ni Sabato ya Bwana, Mungu wako.” Kutoka 20:8-11. Roho wa Mungu aligusa mioyo ya wanafunzi hawa wa Neno Lake. Ushawishi ulikaziwa kwao kwamba walikuwa wameivunja amri ya nne kwa ujinga kwa kupuuza siku ya mapumziko ya Muumbaji.

Hawakuweza kupata ushahidi wowote katika Maandiko kwamba amri ya nne ilikuwa imefutwa, au kwamba Sabato ilikuwa imebadilishwa; baraka ambayo ilitakasa siku ya saba mara ya kwanza haikuwa imewahi kuondolewa. Mara moja walionyesha uaminifu wao kwa Mungu kwa kuitunza Sabato Yake kuwa takatifu.

Wale waliokuwa wamekubali nuru kuhusu uombezi wa Kristo na uendelevu wa sheria ya Mungu, waligundua kuwa hizi ndizo kweli zilizoonyeshwa katika ujumbe wa tatu. Malaika anatangaza, “Hapa ndipo penye subira ya watakatifu, hao wazishikao amri za Mungu, na imani ya Yesu.” Ufunuo 14:12. Kauli hii inatanguliwa na onyo zito na la kutisha dhidi ya kumwabudu mnyama na sanamu yake.

en: By this first beast is represented the Roman Church, an ecclesiastical body clothed with civil power, having authority to punish all dissenters. The image to the beast represents another religious body clothed with similar powers. The formation of this image is the work of that beast whose peaceful rise and mild professions render it so striking a symbol of the United States. Here is to be found an image of the Papacy. When the churches of our land, uniting upon such points of faith as are held by them in common, shall influence the State to enforce their decrees and sustain their institutions, then will Protestant America have formed an image of the Roman hierarchy. Then the true church will be assailed by persecution, as were God’s ancient people.

The beast with lamblike horns commands “all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: and that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.” Revelation 13:16, 17. This is the mark concerning which the third angel utters his warning. It is the mark of the first beast, or the Papacy, and is therefore to be sought among the distinguishing characteristics of that power.

The prophet Daniel declared that the Roman Church, symbolized by the little horn, was to think to change times and laws (Daniel 7:25), while Paul styled it the man of sin (2 Thessalonians 2:3, 4), who was to exalt himself above God. Only by changing God’s law could the Papacy exalt itself above God; whoever should understandingly keep the law as thus changed would be giving supreme honor to that power by which the change was made.

The fourth commandment, which Rome has endeavored to set aside, is the only precept of the Decalogue that points to God as the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and thus distinguishes the true God from all false gods. The Sabbath was instituted to commemorate the work of creation, and thus to direct the minds of men to the true and living God. Had the Sabbath always been kept, there would never have been an idolater, an atheist, or an infidel.

That institution which points to God as the Creator is a sign of His rightful authority over the beings He has made. The change of the Sabbath is the sign, or mark, of the authority of the Romish Church. Those who, understanding the claims of the fourth commandment, choose to observe the false in place of the true Sabbath, are thereby paying homage to that power by which alone it is commanded.
sw: Kwa mnyama huyu wa kwanza, Kanisa la Roma linawakilishwa, ambalo ni taasisi ya kikanisa iliyovikwa nguvu za kiserikali, ikiwa na mamlaka ya kuwaadhibu wote wanaopingana nayo. Sanamu ya mnyama inawakilisha taasisi nyingine ya kidini iliyovikwa nguvu zinazofanana na hizo. Kuundwa kwa sanamu hii ni kazi ya yule mnyama ambaye kuinuka kwake kwa amani na madai yake ya upole yanamfanya kuwa alama ya kushangaza ya Marekani. Hapa ndipo itakapopatikana sanamu ya Upapa. Wakati makanisa ya nchi yetu, yakiungana katika mambo ya imani wanayokubaliana, yatakaposhawishi Serikali kulazimisha amri zao na kutegemeza taasisi zao, hapo ndipo Marekani ya Kiprotestanti itakapokuwa imeunda sanamu ya utawala wa Roma. Kisha kanisa la kweli litashambuliwa kwa mateso, kama walivyokuwa watu wa Mungu wa kale.

Mnyama mwenye pembe kama za mwanakondoo anaamuru “wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa, na matajiri kwa maskini, na walio huru kwa watumwa, watiwe chapa katika mkono wa kuume au katika vipaji vya nyuso zao; tena kwamba mtu awaye yote asiweze kununua wala kuuza, isipokuwa ana chapa ile, yaani, jina la mnyama yule, au hesabu ya jina lake.” Ufunuo 13:16, 17. Hii ndiyo chapa ambayo malaika wa tatu anatoa onyo kuihusu. Ni chapa ya mnyama wa kwanza, au Upapa, na kwa hivyo inapaswa kutafutwa miongoni mwa sifa bainifu za mamlaka hiyo.

Nabii Danieli alitangaza kwamba Kanisa la Roma, likiwakilishwa na pembe ndogo, lingefikiri kubadili majira na sheria (Danieli 7:25), wakati Paulo aliliita mtu wa kuasi (2 Wathesalonike 2:3, 4), ambaye angejiinua juu ya Mungu. Ni kwa kubadili sheria ya Mungu pekee ndipo Upapa ungeweza kujiinua juu ya Mungu; yeyote ambaye kwa ufahamu angeishika sheria hiyo kama ilivyobadilishwa, atakuwa akitoa heshima kuu kwa mamlaka ile iliyofanya mabadiliko hayo.

Amri ya nne, ambayo Roma imejaribu kuiweka kando, ndiyo agizo pekee la Amri Kumi linaloashiria Mungu kama Muumbaji wa mbingu na nchi, na hivyo kumtofautisha Mungu wa kweli na miungu yote ya uongo. Sabato ilianzishwa ili kukumbuka kazi ya uumbaji, na hivyo kuelekeza akili za wanadamu kwa Mungu wa kweli na aliye hai. Kama Sabato ingekuwa imetunzwa sikuzote, kusingekuwa na mwabudu sanamu, mkanamungu (atheist), au asiyeamini.

Taasisi hiyo inayoashiria Mungu kama Muumbaji ni ishara ya mamlaka Yake halali juu ya viumbe Alivyovifanya. Mabadiliko ya Sabato ni ishara, au chapa, ya mamlaka ya Kanisa la Roma. Wale ambao, wakielewa madai ya amri ya nne, wanachagua kuishika Sabato ya uongo badala ya ile ya kweli, kwa kufanya hivyo wanatoa heshima kwa mamlaka hiyo ambayo pekee ndiyo iliyoamuru mabadiliko hayo.

en: The most fearful threatening ever addressed to mortals is contained in the third angel’s message. That must be a terrible sin which calls down the wrath of God unmingled with mercy. Men are not to be left in darkness concerning this important matter; the warning against this sin is to be given to the world before the visitation of God’s judgments, that all may know why they are to be inflicted, and have opportunity to escape them.

In the issue of the great contest, two distinct, opposite classes are developed. One class “worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark,” and thus bring upon themselves the awful judgments threatened by the third angel. The other class, in marked contrast to the world, “keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.” Revelation 14:9, 12.

Such were the momentous truths that opened before those who received the third angel’s message. As they reviewed their experience from the first proclamation of the second advent to the passing of the time in 1844, they saw their disappointment explained, and hope and joy again animated their hearts.

Light from the sanctuary illuminated the past, the present, and the future, and they knew that God had led them by His unerring providence. Now with new courage and firmer faith, they joined in giving the warning of the third angel. Since 1844, in fulfillment of the prophecy of the third angel’s message, the attention of the world has been called to the true Sabbath, and a constantly increasing number are returning to the observance of God’s holy day.
sw: Tishio la kutisha zaidi kuwahi kutolewa kwa wanadamu limo katika ujumbe wa malaika wa tatu. Lazima hiyo iwe dhambi ya kutisha inayoshusha ghadhabu ya Mungu isiyochanganyika na rehema. Wanadamu hawapaswi kuachwa gizani kuhusu jambo hili muhimu; onyo dhidi ya dhambi hii linapaswa kutolewa kwa ulimwengu kabla ya ujio wa hukumu za Mungu, ili wote wajue ni kwa nini zinatolewa, na wapate nafasi ya kuziepuka.

Katika matokeo ya pambano hili kuu, makundi mawili tofauti na yanayopingana yanatokea. Kundi moja “wanamwabudu mnyama na sanamu yake, na kuipokea chapa yake,” na hivyo kujiletea wenyewe hukumu za kutisha zilizotishwa na malaika wa tatu. Kundi lile lingine, likiwa na utofauti mkubwa na ulimwengu, “wanazishika amri za Mungu, na imani ya Yesu.” Ufunuo 14:9, 12.

Hizo ndizo zilikuwa kweli muhimu sana zilizofunguka mbele ya wale waliopokea ujumbe wa malaika wa tatu. Walipopitia uzoefu wao tangu kutangazwa kwa mara ya kwanza kwa marejeo ya pili hadi kupita kwa muda mnamo 1844, waliona kukatishwa tamaa kwao kukielezewa, na tumaini na furaha vikahuisha mioyo yao tena.

Nuru kutoka patakatifu iliangaza wakati uliopita, sasa, na ujao, nao walijua kuwa Mungu alikuwa amewaongoza kwa majaliwa Yake yasiyokosea. Sasa kwa ujasiri mpya na imani thabiti zaidi, waliungana katika kutoa onyo la malaika wa tatu. Tangu 1844, katika utimilifu wa unabii wa ujumbe wa malaika wa tatu, fikira za ulimwengu zimeelekezwa kwenye Sabato ya kweli, na idadi inayoongezeka kila mara wanarejea kwenye ushikaji wa siku takatifu ya Mungu.

en: The descendants of Seth were called the sons of God; the descendants of Cain, the sons of men. As the sons of God mingled with the sons of men, they became corrupt and, by intermarriage with them, lost, through the influence of their wives, their peculiar, holy character, and united with the sons of Cain in their idolatry. Many cast aside the fear of God and trampled upon His commandments. But there were a few that did righteousness, who feared and honored their Creator. Noah and his family were among the righteous few.

The wickedness of man was so great, and increased to such a fearful extent, that God repented that He had made man upon the earth, for He saw that the wickedness of man was great, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually. More than one hundred years before the Flood the Lord sent an angel to faithful Noah to make known to him that He would no longer have mercy upon the corrupt race.

Noah was to preach to the people, and also to prepare an ark as God should direct him for the saving of himself and family. He was not only to preach, but his example in building the ark was to convince all that he believed what he preached. Noah and his family were not alone in fearing and obeying God. But Noah was the most pious and holy of any upon the earth, and was the one whose life God preserved to carry out His will in building the ark and warning the world of its coming doom.

God gave all who chose an opportunity to repent and turn to Him. But they believed not the preaching of Noah. They mocked at his warnings and ridiculed the building of that immense vessel on dry land. Noah’s efforts to reform his fellow men did not succeed. But for more than one hundred years he persevered in his efforts to turn men to repentance and to God. Every blow struck upon the ark was preaching to the people. Noah directed, he preached, he worked, while the people looked on in amazement and regarded him as a fanatic.
sw: Wazao wa Sethi waliitwa wana wa Mungu; wazao wa Kaini waliitwa wana wa wanadamu. Wana wa Mungu walipochanganyika na wana wa wanadamu, wakawa wapotovu na, kwa kuoana nao, walipoteza tabia yao takatifu na ya pekee kupitia ushawishi wa wake zao, na kuungana na wana wa Kaini katika ibada yao ya sanamu. Wengi walitupilia mbali hofu ya Mungu na kuzikanyaga amri Zake. Lakini walikuwapo wachache waliotenda haki, waliomcha na kumheshimu Muumba wao. Nuhu na familia yake walikuwa miongoni mwa wale wachache wenye haki.

Uovu wa mwanadamu ulikuwa mkubwa sana, na uliongezeka kwa kiasi cha kutisha, kiasi kwamba Mungu alijuta kwamba amemfanya mwanadamu duniani, kwani aliona kuwa uovu wa mwanadamu ulikuwa mkubwa, na kwamba kila fikira ya mawazo ya moyo wake ilikuwa mbaya tu daima. Zaidi ya miaka mia moja kabla ya Gharika, Bwana alimtuma malaika kwa Nuhu mwaminifu ili kumfahamisha kuwa Hatakuwa na rehema tena juu ya kizazi hicho kipotovu.

Nuhu alipaswa kuhubiri kwa watu, na pia kuandaa safina kama Mungu alivyomwelekeza kwa ajili ya kujiokoa yeye na familia yake. Hakupaswa kuhubiri tu, bali mfano wake katika kujenga safina ulipaswa kuwashawishi wote kwamba aliamini kile alichokihubiri. Nuhu na familia yake hawakuwa peke yao katika kumcha na kumtii Mungu. Lakini Nuhu alikuwa mcha Mungu na mtakatifu zaidi ya yeyote duniani, na ndiye ambaye Mungu alihifadhi maisha yake ili kutekeleza mapenzi Yake katika kujenga safina na kuuonya ulimwengu juu ya maangamizi yake yanayokuja.

Mungu alimpa kila aliyechagua fursa ya kutubu na kumgeukia Yeye. Lakini hawakuamini mahubiri ya Nuhu. Walidhihaki maonyo yake na kucheka ujenzi wa chombo kile kikubwa nchi kavu. Jitihada za Nuhu za kuwarekebisha wanadamu wenzake hazikufanikiwa. Lakini kwa zaidi ya miaka mia moja alivumilia katika jitihada zake za kuwageuza watu kwenye toba na kwa Mungu. Kila pigo lililopigwa juu ya safina lilikuwa ni mahubiri kwa watu. Nuhu alielekeza, alihubiri, na alifanya kazi, wakati watu wakitazama kwa mshangao na kumchukulia kama mwehu.

en: The cross reveals God’s love and justice
Christ bore the penalty of sin
Salvation is a gift through sacrifice
sw: Msalaba unaonyesha upendo na haki ya Mungu
Kristo alichukua adhabu ya dhambi
Wokovu ni zawadi kupitia dhabihu

en: God gave Noah the exact dimensions of the ark and explicit directions in regard to the construction of it in every particular. In many respects it was not made like a vessel but prepared like a house, the foundation like a boat which would float upon water. There were no windows in the sides of the ark. It was three stories high, and the light they received was from a window in the top. The door was in the side. The different apartments prepared for the reception of different animals were so made that the window in the top gave light to all. The ark was made of the cypress or gopher wood, which would know nothing of decay for hundreds of years. It was a building of great durability, which no wisdom of man could invent. God was the designer, and Noah His master builder.

After Noah had done all in his power to make every part of the work correct, it was impossible that it could of itself withstand the violence of the storm which God in His fierce anger was to bring upon the earth. The work of completing the building was a slow process. Every piece of timber was closely fitted, and every seam covered with pitch. All that men could do was done to make the work perfect; yet, after all, God alone could preserve the building upon the angry, heaving billows, by His miraculous power.

A multitude at first apparently received the warning of Noah, yet did not fully turn to God with true repentance. There was some time given them before the Flood was to come, in which they were to be placed upon probation—to be proved and tried. They failed to endure the trial. The prevailing degeneracy overcame them, and they finally joined others who were corrupt in deriding and scoffing at faithful Noah. They would not leave off their sins but continued in polygamy and in the indulgence of their corrupt passions.

The period of their probation was drawing near its close. The unbelieving, scoffing inhabitants of the world were to have a special sign of God’s divine power. Noah had faithfully followed the instructions God had given to him. The ark was finished exactly as God had directed. He had laid in store immense quantities of food for man and beast. And after this was accomplished, God commanded the faithful Noah, “Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before Me.”
sw: Mungu alimpa Nuhu vipimo kamili vya safina na maelekezo ya wazi kuhusiana na ujenzi wake katika kila kipengele. Katika mambo mengi haikutengenezwa kama merikebu bali iliandaliwa kama nyumba, msingi wake ukiwa kama boti ambayo ingeelea juu ya maji. Hapakuwa na madirisha pembeni mwa safina. Ilikuwa na urefu wa ghorofa tatu, na mwanga walioupata ulitoka kwenye dirisha lililokuwa juu. Mlango ulikuwa pembeni. Vyumba tofauti vilivyoandaliwa kwa ajili ya kupokea wanyama mbalimbali vilitengenezwa kiasi kwamba dirisha la juu lilitoa mwanga kwa vyote. Safina ilitengenezwa kwa mti wa sayprosi au mgofero, ambao haungejua kuoza kwa mamia ya miaka. Lilikuwa jengo la uimara mkubwa, ambalo hakuna hekima ya mwanadamu ingeweza kuvumbua. Mungu alikuwa msanifu, na Nuhu alikuwa mjenzi mkuu Wake.

Baada ya Nuhu kufanya kila kitu katika uwezo wake ili kuhakikisha kila sehemu ya kazi iko sahihi, haikuwezekana kwamba chombo hicho kingeweza kuhimili chenyewe vurugu za dhoruba ambayo Mungu katika ghadhabu Yake kali angeileta juu ya dunia. Kazi ya kukamilisha jengo hilo ilikuwa mchakato wa polepole. Kila kipande cha mbao kiliunganishwa kwa ukaribu, na kila mshono ulifunikwa na lami. Kila kitu ambacho wanadamu wangeweza kufanya kilifanyika ili kuifanya kazi hiyo kuwa kamilifu; hata hivyo, baada ya yote, Mungu pekee ndiye angeweza kulihifadhi jengo hilo juu ya mawimbi yenye hasira na yanayopanda, kwa nguvu Yake ya kimuujiza.

Umati wa watu hapo awali walionekana kupokea onyo la Nuhu, lakini hawakumgeukia Mungu kikamilifu kwa toba ya kweli. Kulikuwa na muda waliopewa kabla ya Gharika kuja, ambapo walipaswa kuwekwa katika kipindi cha majaribio—ili kuthibitishwa na kujaribiwa. Walishindwa kuvumilia jaribu hilo. Uharibifu uliokuwa umeenea uliwashinda, na hatimaye wakajiunga na wengine waliokuwa wapotovu katika kumdhihaki na kumfanyia mzaha Nuhu mwaminifu. Hawakuacha dhambi zao bali waliendelea katika mitala na kujiingiza katika tamaa zao mbaya.

Kipindi cha majaribio yao kilikuwa kikikaribia mwisho wake. Wakazi wa ulimwengu wasioamini na wenye kudhihaki walipaswa kuwa na ishara maalum ya nguvu ya kimungu ya Mungu. Nuhu alikuwa amefuata kwa uaminifu maelekezo ambayo Mungu alikuwa amempa. Safina ilikamilika sawasawa na vile Mungu alivyoelekeza. Alikuwa amehifadhi kiasi kikubwa cha chakula kwa ajili ya mwanadamu na mnyama. Na baada ya haya kukamilika, Mungu akamwamuru Nuhu mwaminifu, “Ingia wewe na nyumba yako yote katika safina; kwa maana nimekuona wewe kuwa ni mwenye haki mbele zangu.”

en: The cross reveals God’s love and justice
Christ bore the penalty of sin
Salvation is a gift through sacrifice
sw: Msalaba unaonyesha upendo na haki ya Mungu
Kristo alichukua adhabu ya dhambi
Wokovu ni zawadi kupitia dhabihu

en: Angels were sent to collect from the forest and field the beasts which God had created. Angels went before these animals, and they followed, two and two, male and female, and clean beasts by sevens. These beasts, from the most ferocious, down to the most gentle and harmless, peacefully and solemnly marched into the ark. The sky seemed clouded with birds of every description. They came flying to the ark, two and two, male and female, and the clean birds by sevens. The world looked on with wonder—some with fear, but they had become so hardened by rebellion that this most signal manifestation of God’s power had but a momentary influence upon them.

And as the doomed race beheld the sun shining in its glory and the earth clad in almost its Eden beauty, they drove away their rising fears by boisterous merriment, and by their deeds of violence seemed to be encouraging upon themselves the visitation of the already awakened wrath of God. Everything was now ready for the closing of the ark, which could not have been done by Noah from within. An angel is seen by the scoffing multitude descending from heaven, clothed with brightness like the lightning. He closes that massive outer door, and then takes his course upward to heaven again.
